result.title: How Much of SAR Vehicle Recognition Is the Vehicle? Background Shortcuts, Angle Gaps and Partial Libraries on MSTAR and ATRNet-STAR
result.summary: Deep networks score near 99% on the MSTAR vehicle benchmark, and the newer ATRNet-STAR benchmark was built to be harder. We ask how much of these scores comes from the vehicle itself. With a modern network (ConvNeXt-Small, 3 seeds) we first reproduce the known MSTAR result: with the central 96x96 pixels zeroed out, accuracy is still 73.3% (chance 10%). The same shortcut is present in ATRNet-STAR, which was collected across several scenes: with the vehicle removed, accuracy is 63.3% on the 40-class SOC split (chance 2.5%). Under the official scene-change split, the background stops helping and starts hurting. Accuracy is 22.8% on full chips and 30.8% when only the vehicle is shown. A SAR foundation model, SARATR-X, leans on the background more than ConvNeXt does (+4 to +6 points with the vehicle removed, in every seed) and does not solve the scene change. We then hold the amount of training data fixed and vary the depression angles used for training. Accuracy is set mainly by the gap to the nearest training angle: 57% at 15 degrees, 39% at 30 degrees and 26% at 45 degrees. Adding more training angles does not help. Finally, when most classes have training images at the test angle and a few do not, the missing classes do worse than when no class has them: 9.0% instead of 22.4% at a 45-degree gap. Most of their images are assigned to known classes. We recommend reporting background-only and target-only controls, and the angle gap, next to any accuracy figure. Code is public.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在 MSTAR 与 ATRNet-STAR 上用 ConvNeXt-Small（3 个种子）和 SAR 基础模型 SARATR-X 做「去掉目标」与「只留目标」的对照，并固定训练数据量改变训练俯仰角，发现高分很大程度来自背景捷径，且性能主要由与最近训练角度的间隔决定，据此建议同时报告 background-only、target-only 与角度间隔。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「背景-only / 目标-only」控制与分布位移下的部分类别覆盖分析，可能为核查 VLM 答案是否真正依赖任务相关视觉证据（而非上下文或语言先验捷径）提供评测设计参照；但对象为 SAR 非生成式模型，与 latent 状态生成和使用机制无直接联系，需较多核查。
